title: ⚙️Mythical Machinery⚙️
description: A steampunk fantasy modpack where medieval magic meets industrial automation.
body:
### 🐉 Features
- Create-powered machinery
- Dragons and mythical creatures (Ice and Fire)
- RPG progression and exploration
- Medieval + Industrial tech balance

### 🛠️ Recommended Specs
- RAM: 6–8 GB
- CPU: 4 cores+

### 📦 Based Mods
- Create
- Ice and Fire
